purpose: Teach: こみ/削る/利く/扱える/照らさ/考え直し/挙がっ/緩め

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 通勤ラッシュ、人こみが激しい時間、避けたい。
lines.en: I'd rather avoid the worst of the morning rush — the crowds can be intense.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, slightly weary. Conversational complaint, not quite a request. Said while glancing at transit schedule or planner. No drama, just preference stated plainly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。コスト、削る方向で進めます。
lines.en: Understood. We'll look at where we can trim costs.
lines.style: Straightforward, attentive. The tone of someone taking notes — literally or mentally. No hesitation, but not overeager. Professional courtesy underneath.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 部下の判断、利く社員、頼もしいね。
lines.en: It's impressive when junior staff can make those kinds of calls. It makes things easier on everyone.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation, warm. Pauses slightly on 「impressive」 — she means it. Soft, encouraging. The tone of someone noticing growth in people she works with.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。複雑な案件も、扱える者が、育ってきました。
lines.en: Yes. We've had some good people step up to handle the trickier projects.
lines.style: Quiet pride. Not boastful — just factual observation with an undertone of 「I've watched this happen and it matters」. Steady, measured.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プレゼン、舞台、ライトで照らされて、よく見えた。
lines.en: The presentation went well — seeing it up on stage under the lights really brought it into focus.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly distant. She's replaying the moment in her head. Thoughtful pace. Softer attack, trailing off gently as if still processing what she saw.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。改めて考え直したい案件、まとめます。
lines.en: I'll collect the feedback points we need to revisit and get those organized.
lines.style: Decisive but not rushed. A promise to follow through. Clear, compact delivery — she knows what she's committing to and she'll do it.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 反対意見、複数挙がってきたよね。
lines.en: We got quite a few different perspectives on this one — some of them pushing back pretty hard.
lines.style: Neutral observation with a hint of concern underneath. Not complaining, just noting the weight of the disagreement. Slight emphasis on 「quite a few」.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。スケジュール、緩めに調整します。
lines.en: Right. I'll adjust the timeline to give us some buffer room — we'll need it.
lines.style: Pragmatic acceptance. No defensiveness, just making the adjustment in real-time as they talk. Clear and brief. The tone of someone who sees the solution already.
